about: 20 navigation questions about this repository (T-209). Each answer was checked with drspec before the runs (the tool named in verified_with). A run is correct when its answer matches every regex in `key` (case-insensitive). Kinds: callers, definitions, live_text, absence. Not covered: member access (no C++ in the repo) and config keys (the CI yaml files are not in the index).

instructions.A:
drspec keeps a code graph of this project: use `search`, `deps_get` and `unused` instead of grepping for functions.
Contracts: do not write them for every function (a first scan leaves thousands PENDING). Run the contract workflow (proposer, then critic) in a sub-agent only before changing a PENDING or STALE function that has callers, when the user asks why or how a function behaves, or when a scan lists changed functions; not for VERIFIED functions with an unchanged hash, tests, one-line wrappers or generated files. One sub-agent per function (a group of at most 5), which returns the saved contract id and confidence, not the transcript. At most 5 functions per run without asking the user, at most 20 after the user says yes; then say how many PENDING and STALE functions remain instead of continuing.
refs_get lists the accesses whose receiver type is unknown counted by file by default (`unresolved`: files, full or count; full lists each one).
strings_get: who sets a YAML config key (`avoidance/timeout`) and which code reads it by name (exact string literals); a key ending with `/` lists each leaf with its value and reader; `problems: true` lists the yaml files that could not be read.
Every tool takes `format: "compact"` (the default, "text", is unchanged): the same data in a third fewer characters. A compact result starts with `~B` (or `~J` and the JSON of the whole result). `key: value` is a field; a value starting `{` or `[` is JSON; `note: ~I` is the usual "Index incomplete: N of M files are not scanned yet" note built from `index`; `~1` is the hint that searched files are not in the graph yet, `~2` the caveat that `unused` is a candidate list, not proof. `# key f1 f2..` starts function records with those fields; `>dir/` names the directory of the files below it, ` file` a file, `  name#hash<TAB>k=v..` a function in it. THE FUNCTION ID for `source_get` or `deps_get` is the directory and file of its group, `::`, then `name#hash`: `src/a/b.py::name#hash`. Unwritten fields have their default (status="PENDING" possibly_stale=false has_contract=false only_test_callers=false relation="calls" confidence="EXTRACTED"; function_name is the last part of the name). Keys: s=signature st=status p=possibly_stale c=has_contract d=depth r=relation cf=confidence n=function_name o=only_test_callers. A signature past 80 characters ends with `…` (`source_get` has it whole). `^ hits`: under a file, `line<TAB>function<TAB>text` (`=` the row above's function, empty none, `!id` another file's). `% blocks`: `@a-b<TAB>matched lines<TAB>functions`, then lines a..b each led by `:` (matched) or `-`. `& owners`: `*Owner<TAB>count`, files, functions, then `line<TAB>kind<TAB>site<TAB>source`. `= key f1 f2..`: other lists of records, one `|cell<TAB>cell` row each (`~` a field the row lacks); a `<TAB>f=v` after a field list gives every row that value; `{ key` .. `}` holds the lists of a field; in a record `!k` means it has no `k`, and `f[a,b]` in the field list means rows of three spaces and the cells a,b follow each record. A result that does not start with `~B` is the plain text form (sent when it is the shorter). `source_get` is never compacted.
instructions.B:
Codebase navigation: drspec first. Do not use grep, rg, find or other shell text search for code when a drspec tool answers the question.
- callers, callees, dependencies: `deps_get`
- where a function is defined; find by name, text or meaning: `search` (`semantic: true` for meaning)
- text of live lines, constants included: `search` with `lines: true` (the grep replacement)
- who reads or writes a member (C++): `refs_get`
- a yaml/config key set and read in code: `strings_get`
- unused functions: `unused`; one function's code: `source_get`; what is indexed or stale: `status`
Shell search is for what drspec does not index (logs, build output, files outside the project) or when drspec is unavailable; an incomplete index is no reason to skip drspec. A claim that nothing calls, uses or sets something ("no callers", "never used", "not set") is checked with `search` in `lines` mode, not shell grep: unresolved calls and changed files can hide a use.
Contracts: do not write them for every function (a first scan leaves thousands PENDING). Run the contract workflow (proposer, then critic) in a sub-agent only before changing a PENDING or STALE function that has callers, when the user asks why or how a function behaves, or when a scan lists changed functions; not for VERIFIED functions with an unchanged hash, tests, one-line wrappers or generated files. One sub-agent per function (a group of at most 5), which returns the saved contract id and confidence, not the transcript. At most 5 functions per run without asking the user, at most 20 after the user says yes; then say how many PENDING and STALE functions remain instead of continuing.
Output format: `text` is the default; `format: "compact"` is opt-in, about a third fewer characters. A compact result starts with `~B` (or `~J` and the JSON of the whole result); one without it is text (sent when that is shorter). `key: value` a field (a value starting `{` or `[` is JSON); `note: ~I` the index note; `~1` searched files not in the graph yet; `~2` `unused` is a candidate list, not proof. `# key f1 f2..` function records with those fields; `>dir/` a directory of the files below; ` file` a file; `  name#hash<TAB>k=v..` a function. THE FUNCTION ID for `source_get` or `deps_get` is the group's directory and file, `::`, then `name#hash`: `src/a/b.py::name#hash`. Unwritten fields have their default (status="PENDING" possibly_stale=false has_contract=false only_test_callers=false relation="calls" confidence="EXTRACTED"; function_name is the name's last part). Keys: s=signature st=status p=possibly_stale c=has_contract d=depth r=relation cf=confidence n=function_name o=only_test_callers. A signature past 80 characters ends with `…`. `^ key` hits: `line<TAB>function<TAB>text` (`=` the row above's function, empty none, `!id` another file's). `% key` blocks: `@a-b<TAB>matched lines<TAB>functions`, then lines a..b, `:` matched, `-` context. `& key` owners: `*Owner<TAB>count`, files, functions, then `line<TAB>kind<TAB>site<TAB>source`. `= key f1 f2..` other records: `|cell<TAB>cell` rows (`~` a missing field; `<TAB>f=v` gives every row that value). `{ key` .. `}` holds the lists of a field. In a record `!k` means no `k`; `f[a,b]` means rows of three spaces and cells a,b under each record. `source_get` is never compacted.
